:::{#def-stationary-sequence}
#### Stationary sequence

A **stationary sequence** is a sequence $X_1, X_2, \ldots$ of [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv)
whose [joint probability mass functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-joint-pmf) do not change when the sequence is shifted in time:
for every length $k \ge 1$, every shift $s \ge 0$ and all values $x_1, \ldots, x_k$,

$$\P(X_{1+s} = x_1, \ldots, X_{k+s} = x_k) = \P(X_1 = x_1, \ldots, X_k = x_k).$$

:::
